mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% annualized rate signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 3% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals improving supply chain conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4.75% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 2.5% annualized, it signals tightening monetary policy with high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 58% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a very tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 1.2-year rolling window during mid-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% annualized signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but this effect is muted during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 52% of instances with RSAFS growth > 5% annualized during non-tightening cycles.
